summary: Walks a scene list (this+0xF0 head, count at this+0xFC). For each node it dereferences the node value, then a sub-object pointer at value+0x3C, and compares the sub-object's path string (offset 0x104) against dword_7CE5EC, falling back to byte_5EA438 when the global is null. On the first match it stores the index at this+0x174, then calls TrackSceneLoader with the node's name string (value+0x4, defaulting to byte_5EA438) and returns AIW(0). If no match is found and the list is non-empty it falls back to the first entry: this+0x174 = 0, loads the first node's name, and returns AIW(0). Called by GameFilterSetup and GameContentFilterCheck.
